deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 4 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Processor Status\""
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 4` output filtered to the `Processor Status` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; extracts a displayed status label but omits raw status byte, per-handle association and populated-socket semantics.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; improves status policy and optional OS correlation but misclassifies an automatable read-only core because expected policy and reboot approval are inputs.

original_test_intent: Verify each SMBIOS Type 4 Processor Status byte correctly describes whether the socket is populated and the processor's enabled/disabled/idle/other state, and that the approved state remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw and decoded Type 4 records, identify each socket and handle, decode the populated bit separately from the processor-status bits, compare with the approved socket inventory and intentional CPU-disable policy, reboot, then repeat without changing CPU state.
manual_activity: A user approves socket inventory, allowed disabled-state policy, any OS correlation and the reboot plan. Raw collection, bit decoding and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Expected socket population and Type 4 handle/socket mapping
Allowed Processor Status state per populated socket and treatment of unpopulated records
SMBIOS-version-aware status-byte decoding and reserved-value policy
Whether OS online/offline state is required as supporting evidence
Validated dmidecode/raw reader plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS and optional OS CPU state only; do not online/offline processors or alter BIOS/firmware.
Preserve the raw status byte and complete record because a decoded label alone can hide the population bit or reserved bits.
Do not infer an error merely from an intentionally disabled processor or an unpopulated socket; compare with the approved platform policy.
Treat OS online state as supporting evidence, not a replacement for the firmware-owned SMBIOS field.
Stop on unexpected state, reserved encoding, mapping ambiguity, record loss or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect and map every Type 4 record, decode the status byte, correlate approved inventory/optional OS state and compare before/after reboot.
Do not change processor state, invent an expected status or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected population/status and any intentional disabled CPU conditions.
Approve reboot/recovery and decide the formal verdict from raw and decoded evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label target is relevant, but grep with suppressed errors loses the raw byte, record boundaries and socket mapping needed to interpret population and status bits.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete decoded and raw Type 4 records, bind Processor Status to handle/socket and decode population and status bits independently; optionally collect read-only OS online state under an approved mapping.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Processor Status scope, Type 4 script and 10/10-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate the raw Type 4 Processor Status byte per socket, separating socket-populated indication from CPU status code, then compare with the approved hardware and disabled-state policy before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, CPU topology, dmidecode/parser and platform-recipe revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 4 Processor Status bit-field semantics, approved CPU population recipe and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw bit-field decoding, topology binding and intentional-disable handling to the generic information check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; optional OS correlation adds evidence without replacing SMBIOS validation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected population/status map and approved correlation rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware and OS may describe different layers; an OS-offline CPU does not alone define the SMBIOS status value.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve populated, enabled, disabled-by-user, disabled-by-BIOS, idle or other defined states per socket; the override must name the topology and may not silently mutate CPU state to make the evidence match.
expected_evidence: Approved socket/status matrix, decoding policy, tool/SMBIOS versions and optional OS-correlation rule
Complete pre-reboot raw and decoded Type 4 records with handle/socket/status byte and population/state interpretation
Approved reboot and platform health evidence
Equivalent complete post-reboot capture and per-socket comparison
Engineer verdict with any intentional disabled-state rationale

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion consistently target Processor Status; expected per-socket states are project inputs rather than a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field can be safely captured and decoded; missing expected topology/status policy is readiness input, not an irreducible ambiguity.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw byte, per-socket mapping and population/status bit semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains policy and optional OS correlation while correcting the capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE and avoiding owner verdict as an execution blocker.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates the SMBIOS population bit from the processor-state code and prevents automatic CPU-state changes.

review_improvement: Makes empty sockets, deliberately disabled CPUs and genuinely invalid status encodings distinguishable in preserved evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: After the approved topology/status policy is supplied, complete read-only collection, bit decoding, mapping and reboot comparison are software-controlled.
